settings.note: Share your wedding date and venue in the planner and we will confirm timelines in your proposal.

settings.question: Can I buy gifts online?
settings.answer: No — ShaadiGifts is a gifting concierge, not an online shop. You browse the collections, add favourites to your wishlist, and submit it with your wedding details. We then send a personalised proposal.

settings.question: How does the wishlist work?
settings.answer: Tap the heart on any gift to save it. Open your wishlist to set quantities and add notes, then choose “Request Personalized Quote”. Nothing is charged and there is no checkout.

settings.question: Are the prices final?
settings.answer: Prices shown are indicative “starting from” prices. Your final quotation depends on quantity, personalisation and packaging.

settings.question: Can you personalise gifts with our names and theme?
settings.answer: Yes. We can add names, monograms, custom tags and message cards, and match packaging to your wedding colours and theme.

settings.question: Do you deliver outside India?
settings.answer: Yes. We serve Indian and international weddings and deliver to your venue, hotel or home. Tell us the country and city in the planner and we will confirm details in your proposal.

settings.question: How early should I start planning?
settings.answer: As early as you can — personalised and packed gifts need time. Share your wedding date in the planner and we will advise on timelines for your quantity and customisation.
